requirements.title: Service and intended use
requirements.ask: Describe the proposed service, its AI use case and intended customer use.

requirements.title: Data and personal information scope

requirements.reading: Northstar specifically asks about employee-data scope.

requirements.title: Storage and inference locations

requirements.reading: Northstar separates storage location from processing and inference geography.

requirements.title: Retention by data type

requirements.reading: Northstar wants retention clarified by data type.

requirements.title: Penetration test and remediation
requirements.ask: Provide the latest penetration test and its remediation status, and address the predicted request for recent red-team or penetration-test evidence.
requirements.reading: Guidance predicts that reports older than about six months may not be accepted; Northstar did not state that threshold.

requirements.title: Encryption and access controls
